articles.title: Introducing Astra for Law
articles.summary: OpenAI announced a legal-work configuration of GPT-6 Astra combining the model with legal search, specialized instructions, and controls for confidential work. Initial access is for selected firms through ChatGPT and Codex, with API access planned; an API lets software interact with the model programmatically.

articles.title: Reimagining advertising with AI
articles.summary: OpenAI is testing Sponsored Agents, clearly labeled conversations with business-sponsored agents after an ad click. It also announced tools for creating and managing ads, plus integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

articles.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
articles.summary: OpenAI introduced a process for investigating and publishing reports of model misalignment: behavior that departs from intended goals or constraints. It released six examples and cautioned that individual incidents do not establish how frequently these behaviors occur.
